readme.run: Compute MRIQC-style quality metrics of a T1-weighted image
notes: Runs the web app's MindGrab segmentation on the CPU, then niimath --qc.
The MindGrab models and the MNI air template are included and checked locally.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Add --model 16chan18cls for labels instead of tissue fractions, --bids for a sidecar,
and --help for every option. DICOM input and manual ratings need the web app.
These are MRIQC-style estimates, not MRIQC normative values. Please cite:
Esteban O, Birman D, Schaer M, Koyejo OO, Poldrack RA, Gorgolewski KJ. MRIQC:
Advancing the automatic prediction of image quality in MRI from unseen sites.
